def load_and_merge(json_path: str, jsonl_path: str = None) -> list:
    records_by_id = {}

                    records_by_id[rid] = rec
                    jsonl_count += 1

    conclusion = rec["conclusion"]

    code_code = rec.get("code_code", "")
    fol_verdict = rec.get("fol_exec", {}).get("verdict", "Error")
    code_verdict = rec.get("code_exec", {}).get("verdict", "Error")
    fol_error = rec.get("fol_exec", {}).get("error")
    code_error = rec.get("code_exec", {}).get("error")

    log.info("C4 targeted: %d/%d (%.1f%%)  blind: %d/%d (%.1f%%)  delta: %+.1fpp",
             tgt_ok, tgt_att, tgt_rate, bld_ok, bld_att, bld_rate, tgt_rate - bld_rate)
